summary: This directory provides utilities for calculating differences between objects, enabling comparison and tracking of modifications within the application state or data structures.
responsibilities: Identify changes between two object structures
Generate representations of modifications or deltas
relationships: The object diffing process compares two snapshots to compute a delta.
Data delta representations are used to express the specific changes identified by the comparison logic.
designDecisions: Isolated testing of comparison logic for reliability
Generic implementation to support various object structures
